commitResults.messageBody:
Java changes need a consistent interpretation of the course coding
conventions.

Add a reusable skill containing the SE-EDU basic and intermediate
checklist. Require agents to load it for Java work while preserving the
course exception for unnamed-package source files.

Commit and branch work needs a shared interpretation of the SE-EDU
conventions to keep repository history consistent.

Add a reusable skill containing the SE-EDU Git checklist. Require agents
to load it before proposing or performing commit and branch operations.

Broke down tasks into 3 new types: Deadline, Event, ToDo as required by Level 4 increment.

- Deadline expects a description and /by arguments
- Event expects a description and /from and /to arguments
- ToDo just needs description

Route todo, deadline, and event commands to their corresponding task types. Validate required descriptions and date/time fields before parsing so malformed commands produce feedback instead of causing a crash.

Update task storage and command output to support typed tasks and report the task count after each addition.

commitResults.messageTitle: chore: Removed now redundant echoCommand() method
chore: Renamed TaskList's declared size variable to be more accurate.
commitResults.messageBody: Old name "EXPECTED_MAXIMUM_SIZE" implied a false limit which ArrayList data structure can exceed. New name "INITIAL_CAPACITY" sounds more accurate

Task-specific delimiter rules in CommandParser couple command routing to
the internal structure of each task type.

Move validation and parsing for to-dos, deadlines, and events into their
respective classes. Delegate from CommandParser so each task type owns its
input rules and malformed input is rejected before construction.

commitResults.messageTitle: Test: Add fail-fast console UI checks
commitResults.messageBody:
Manual console checks are difficult to repeat and compare consistently.

Add a project-specific skill that records UI test cases, checks each
command's output, stops on the first failure, and reports the full console transcript. Include a baseline plan covering every supported command so future behavior changes can be detected.

commitResults.messageTitle: Docs: Require UI tests after code updates
commitResults.messageBody:
Code changes need consistent UI coverage and verification.

Require agents to review the UI test plan and invoke the test-ui skill after every code update. Ensure failures are reported with their actual and expected output so regressions remain visible.
